polish.label: Academic polish
polish.description: Improve the prose without changing facts, data, or citations
polish.prompt: Polish the current selection or manuscript while preserving facts, data, citations, terminology, and uncertainty. Briefly summarize the material changes.

review.label: Pre-submission review
review.description: Find argument, method, and evidence gaps by severity
review.prompt: Review the current manuscript for contribution clarity, reproducible methods, claim-evidence alignment, and citation coverage. Rank concerns by severity and anchor each one to the source text.

outline.label: Structure the manuscript
outline.description: Extract the outline and find missing or repeated sections
outline.prompt: Map the current manuscript's section structure and argument flow. Return a concise outline and identify structural breaks, duplicated content, and missing sections.

cite.label: Check citation support
cite.description: Find claims that need sources without fabricating citations
cite.prompt: Identify claims in the current selection or manuscript that require citation support. Separate supported, weakly supported, and unsupported claims; suggest only verifiable literature and never invent citations.

research.label: Research a question
research.description: Build a sourced research note from the project and verified sources
research.prompt: Research the question I provide next. Prioritize project sources and verifiable literature, distinguish facts from inference and open questions, and preserve source leads.

translate.label: Academic translation
translate.description: Translate Chinese and English while preserving scholarly notation
translate.prompt: Translate the current selection or manuscript: Chinese into academic English and English into clear Chinese. Preserve terminology, data, citations, equations, and Markdown/LaTeX formatting.

nature_writing.name: Nature Manuscript Writing
nature_writing.description: Draft or restructure sections from real claims and evidence
nature_writing.prompt: Restructure the current manuscript's argument and draft the requested section in a Nature-leaning style. Identify evidence gaps first; do not invent results or citations.

nature_polishing.name: Nature Academic Polishing
nature_polishing.description: Polish academic English without changing facts or overstating conclusions
nature_polishing.prompt: Polish the current selection or document in a Nature-leaning style while preserving data, citations, terminology, and uncertainty. Summarize the material changes.

nature_reviewer.name: Nature Mock Review
nature_reviewer.description: Assess significance, rigor, and claim fulfillment as a referee
nature_reviewer.prompt: Run a Nature-style pre-submission review of the current manuscript. Use the real Argument Map, Claim Ledger, and Reviewer data and anchor concerns to the source text.

nature_response.name: Nature Reviewer Response
nature_response.description: Draft or audit point-by-point responses and verified revisions
nature_response.prompt: Draft a point-by-point response using the current reviews and manuscript. Separate completed changes, missing evidence, and justified disagreement, with verifiable manuscript anchors.

nature_citation.name: Nature Citation Support
nature_citation.description: Map manuscript claims to verifiable literature without fabricating citations
nature_citation.prompt: Split the current text into citable claims, find and verify supporting literature, and return a claim-to-source map. Clearly label candidates that remain unverified.

nature_data.name: Nature Data Availability
nature_data.description: Draft or audit data, code, and reproducibility disclosures
nature_data.prompt: Using only real project information, draft or audit the data and code availability statements and list repository, version, and access details that still need author confirmation.

nature_reader.name: Nature Paper Reader
nature_reader.description: Create a source-anchored bilingual close reading and terminology ledger
nature_reader.prompt: Build a source-traceable bilingual close reading of the current paper, preserving sections, figures, equations, citations, and terminology rather than reducing it to a summary.

nature_figure.name: Nature Scientific Figures
nature_figure.description: Plan, generate, and inspect publication figures from real project data
nature_figure.prompt: Confirm the scientific conclusion, real data source, panel plan, and export requirements, then use my chosen Python or R workflow to create and inspect a publication-grade figure.
